summary: Frontend-only testing of the new Renovation Price Calculator (/calculator) and the enhanced InternalLinks integration across the Max Q renovation website. All 10 test cases in the review request passed. Calculator math is correct, sitemap includes /calculator, header & footer links added, featured-calculator-cta and InternalLinks render correctly on all listed pages, no console / page errors, all major routes return HTTP 200.
action_items: (Optional / minor) The review request file references state that LocationPage.jsx should also import and render <InternalLinks />, but it currently does not. /renovatie/hasselt does not display the InternalLinks block. The explicit test criteria #7 listed only the 6 other pages, so this is non-blocking, but main agent may want to add <InternalLinks /> to LocationPage.jsx for consistency with the SEO/linking goal.
critical_code_review_comments: RenovatieCalculator.jsx is clean, well-structured, uses data-testid consistently, and FAQ schema JSON-LD is correctly embedded for SEO.
InternalLinks.jsx renders featured-calculator-cta with strong gradient styling, 6 service links, and 12 location pills as specified.

Breadcrumbs on /renovatie/hasselt show 'Home > Renovatie regio > Hasselt - Renovaties' (third crumb suffix '- Renovaties') vs review request expected 'Hasselt'. This is cosmetic and matches LocationPage labelling convention; not a defect.
Sitemap returns HTTP 200 and contains /calculator entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calculator at /calculator works end-to-end (room/extra/quality selection -> Bereken indicatie -> EUR range + CTA). Verified math: Badkamer + Keuken + Vloerverwarming x Premium(1.35) = 29.025 - 85.725 EUR. Header has 6 nav links including Calculator. Footer has Prijscalculator link. InternalLinks featured-calculator-cta is present on /, /renoveren, /projecten, /contact, /blog, /bedankt, /diensten/* (ServicePage). It is NOT present on /calculator (by design) nor on /renovatie/* (LocationPage - not yet imported there).
